title: MambaTrack: A Simple Baseline for Multiple Object Tracking with State Space Model
task: Online multi-object tracking (MOT), tracking-by-detection
modality: RGB video detections and bounding-box trajectories; the tracker uses detector outputs rather than RGB template-search matching
short_explanation: Discusses occlusion and motion blur as causes of missed detections/fragmented tracklets; handles them through trajectory patching and association, not restoration.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Motion blur is handled at trajectory/MOT association level; RGB template-search restoration remains not reported.

title: Mamba-FETrack: Frame-Event Tracking via State Space Model
task: RGB-Event single-object visual tracking
modality: RGB frames plus event stream converted into event images
short_explanation: Uses RGB-event fusion for fast motion, low illumination, motion blur, and high-dynamic-range tracking conditions.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Robustness comes from event sensing and feature fusion rather than RGB restoration.

title: MambaIR: A Simple Baseline for Image Restoration with State-Space Model
task: Image restoration, including super-resolution, image denoising, real-world denoising, and JPEG compression artifact reduction.
modality: Single-image restoration from low-quality image input to high-quality image output; not video tracking.
short_explanation: Image restoration paper covering SR, Gaussian/real-world denoising, and JPEG artifact reduction; not a tracking paper.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Strong restoration evidence, but no template-search tracking or target-aware restoration evidence.

title: MambaLCT: Boosting Tracking via Long-term Context State Space Model
task: Visual object tracking with long-term video context.
modality: Visual template-search tracking from image/video frames. Use of language, thermal, event, or restoration modalities is not reported as an input to the method.
short_explanation: Reports challenge/attribute evidence for motion blur, low resolution, and occlusion, attributed to long-term context rather than degradation-specific restoration.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Temporal context helps tracking challenges, but degradation-specific restoration or memory update is not reported.

title: Exploring Enhanced Contextual Information for Video-Level Object Tracking
task: Video-level visual object tracking with contextual-information transmission.
modality: Visual object tracking using video clips/search regions. Use of non-RGB modalities, natural-language input, thermal input, event input, or restoration input is not reported for the method.
short_explanation: Mentions blurriness as a challenge for appearance-only trackers and proposes contextual-information transmission, but no degradation-specific handling is reported.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Context/memory is present; degradation-aware restoration or update is not supported by the cards.

title: MM-Tracker: Motion Mamba for UAV-platform Multiple Object Tracking
task: UAV-platform multi-object tracking (MOT)
modality: RGB UAV video with detector features, motion maps, and MOT association; not RGB single-object template-search tracking
short_explanation: Explicitly targets motion-blur-induced detection difficulty using Motion Margin Loss and motion modeling; occlusion appears in qualitative analysis.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Blur handling is detector/motion-feature level, not image restoration or template-search recovery.

title: Robust Tracking via Mamba-based Context-aware Token Learning
task: Visual object tracking with temporal context learned from track tokens.
modality: RGB-style visual template-search tracking from image pairs/video frames. Use of thermal, event, language, or restoration modalities is not reported.
short_explanation: Motion blur and low resolution appear as benchmark attributes, but the method is temporal track-token modeling rather than degradation-specific restoration.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Attribute robustness is not evidence of restoration-oriented Mamba.

title: Multi-State Tracker: Enhancing Efficient Object Tracking via Multi-State Specialization and Interaction
task: Efficient single-object visual tracking
modality: RGB visual tracking
short_explanation: Evaluates/claims robustness under motion blur, low resolution, illumination variation, occlusion, and fast motion through multi-state feature enhancement.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Feature-state enhancement is not degradation-state modeling or image restoration.

title: Hyperspectral Mamba for Hyperspectral Object Tracking
task: Hyperspectral single-object tracking
modality: Hyperspectral video plus false-color hyperspectral images
short_explanation: Hyperspectral tracker reports attributes including illumination variation, low resolution, motion blur, occlusion, and fast motion, with feature-level spectral/spatial/temporal enhancement.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Sensor-rich hyperspectral feature enhancement is distinct from RGB restoration-guided tracking.

title: All-Day Multi-Camera Multi-Target Tracking
task: Multi-camera multi-target tracking
modality: RGBT, using visible RGB and infrared/thermal video
short_explanation: Addresses real low-light/nighttime MCMT with RGBT infrared fusion, not image restoration.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Low-light robustness is sensor-assisted via infrared, not RGB-only restoration.

title: MambaIRv2: Attentive State Space Restoration
task: Image restoration, including classic/lightweight super-resolution, JPEG compression artifact reduction, and Gaussian color image denoising.
modality: Single-image restoration from low-quality observations to high-quality images; not video or visual object tracking.
short_explanation: Image restoration paper covering SR, JPEG artifact reduction, and Gaussian color denoising through attentive state-space restoration.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Strong restoration-oriented Mamba evidence, but no tracking/template-search evidence.

title: Exploring Historical Information for RGBE Visual Tracking with Mamba
task: RGB-Event single-object visual tracking, with additional RGB-T generalization experiments
modality: RGB plus event; additional experiments use visible plus thermal infrared
short_explanation: RGB-event tracker reports fast motion, limited illumination, motion blur, partial occlusion, and degraded-condition attributes; robustness comes from multimodal fusion/history.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Target-aware scan and historical cues are covered, but RGB-only restoration is not.

title: SportMamba: Adaptive Non-Linear Multi-Object Tracking with State Space Models for Team Sports
task: Online multi-object tracking for team sports
modality: RGB sports video detections, player tracklets, ReID appearance features, and motion predictions; not RGB single-object template-search tracking
short_explanation: Sports MOT discusses fast motion, occlusion, motion blur, missed detections, and weakened appearance cues; severe blur remains a limitation.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Blur/occlusion are handled through motion prediction, association, ReID, and EMA updates, not restoration.

title: MambaMOT: State-Space Model as Motion Predictor for Multi-Object Tracking
task: Multi-object tracking (MOT), tracking-by-detection motion prediction
modality: RGB-video MOT through detector outputs and bounding-box tracklets; the Mamba model operates on trajectory boxes, not RGB template-search pairs
short_explanation: Discusses occlusion and nonlinear motion as MOT challenges; operates on trajectory boxes rather than image-quality degradation.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Trajectory-level Mamba motion prediction does not address visual degradation/restoration.

title: MambaTrack: Exploiting Dual-Enhancement for Night UAV Tracking
task: Night UAV single-object tracking with vision-language prompts
modality: RGB video plus language prompt
short_explanation: Night UAV tracker uses Mamba-based low-light enhancement on cropped template/search regions; attributes also include low resolution, occlusion, and fast motion.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Closest evidence for tracking-aware restoration, but it is low-light/night UAV and language-assisted rather than generic RGB degradation.

title: MambaVT: Spatio-Temporal Contextual Modeling for Robust RGB-T Tracking
task: RGB-T single-object visual tracking
modality: RGB plus thermal infrared (visible-thermal)
short_explanation: RGB-T tracker reports low illumination, low resolution, partial occlusion, motion blur, frame loss, camera moving, and fast motion attributes.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Robustness is RGB-T/context based; dynamic template memory is not degradation-aware.

title: MambaNUT: Nighttime UAV Tracking via Mamba-based Adaptive Curriculum Learning
task: Nighttime UAV single-object tracking
modality: RGB video
short_explanation: Nighttime UAV tracker addresses low contrast/brightness/SNR through Vision Mamba and adaptive curriculum learning, without image enhancement.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Low-light feature robustness is curriculum/backbone based, not restoration-guided.

title: MambaEVT: Event Stream-Based Visual Object Tracking Using State Space Model
task: Event-camera single-object visual tracking
modality: Event-only tracking using event streams converted into event images
short_explanation: Event-only tracker discusses low light, high dynamic range, motion blur, fast motion, occlusion-like disappearance, appearance variation, and clutter through event tracking/memory.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Dynamic template memory exists, but not degradation-aware RGB restoration.

title: SMTrack: State-Aware Mamba for Efficient Temporal Modeling in Visual Tracking
task: Visual object tracking with efficient temporal modeling.
modality: RGB visual tracking. The paper explicitly contrasts SMTrack with MambaVT for RGB-T tracking.
short_explanation: SMTrack mentions motion blur and template degradation; a template evaluator for high-quality hidden-state updating is analyzed but not central to final degradation handling.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Template memory/update is strong evidence, but restoration and explicit synthetic degradation handling are not reported.

title: InvTrack: Efficient Deep Object Tracking Neural Network with Invariant Feature Learning
task: Single-object visual object tracking under image-quality degradation.
modality: RGB/video template-search tracking with clean and synthetically degraded template/search samples during training.
short_explanation: Degradation-invariant tracker uses synthetic blur, downsampling, noise, and JPEG corruption with clean/degraded feature consistency and four-way response-map fusion.
notes_for_gap_analysis: Direct degradation-invariant template-search evidence, but no Mamba or restoration objective.
